# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RSI_DIVERGENCE_REVERSAL_OOS_VALIDATION

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The VWAP_RSI_DIVERGENCE_REVERSAL setup captures short-term mean-reversion when price deviates significantly from the session VWAP while RSI indicates overextension, expecting a snap-back to VWAP. This edge exists because intraday momentum often exhausts at VWAP extremes, and RSI divergence provides a timely reversal signal.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** On 5‑minute bars, trigger when (a) price deviates >0.30% from session VWAP (above for short, below for long) AND (b) RSI(14) >70 (short) or <30 (long) with bearish/bullish divergence (price makes higher high/low while RSI makes lower high/higher low). Enter at next bar open with ITM‑2 0DTE put/call respectively.  
**Exit:** Primary stop is chart‑stop: close beyond VWAP +0.20% (short) or ‑0.20% (long). Profit‑target is VWAP re‑touch (first touch of VWAP after entry) with trailing chandelier profit‑lock arming at +50% premium and trailing 15% off high‑water mark. Time stop 15:50 ET.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% per‑trade risk cap.  
2. **Sample bias:** Using 12‑month window (2025‑07‑01 to 2026‑06‑30) risks over‑fit if regime shifts; walk‑forward OOS will mitigate but sample size (≈250 trading days) still modest for rare divergence events.  
3. **Out‑of‑sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk‑forward OOS will be performed as part of this candidate’s pre‑merge gate).  
4. **Real‑fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (validation on top‑3 J days will be performed after OOS).  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst‑case day (large gap through VWAP with no re‑touch), max drawdown from consecutive losing divergences, blow‑up scenario if VWAP fails to act as magnet in strong trend days. Exact metrics unknown pending backtest.  
6. **Concentration:** Unknown; will disclose top‑5‑day % of P&L after OOS.

## Pre‑merge gate

- Gym validators (unit tests for VWAP, RSI divergence detection).

- Real‑fills validation on the three J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) confirming simulated P&L within ±20% of OP‑real fills.
